name: mast-service
description: The supervisor's Windows service, on supervised units only. With -Supervised (the unit's registry entry says supervised: true; injected by the build) it runs MAST_supervision's own installer, <Top>\supervision\install\install-mast-service.ps1, and fails when the checkout has none. Without it, it removes mast-service through provisioning's own removal, so a unit taken off supervision loses it whatever its checkout holds. It never starts the service: mast-services-standdown (20) stops it at the start of every run and mast-services-finalize (9500) starts it at the end. Runs after mast (2200), which lays down the supervision checkout and its venv, and nssm (1200). Hash-driven, not always: the flag and the supervision pin (tools/mast-repos.tsv) are in its hash. See docs/decisions/2026-11-12-provisioning-installs-and-runs-mast-service-on-supervised-units.md.
